coverage.assessment: The Rysdale, Annie-vacancy, Ritz/Cowley, Paddington-box and Llanelly setups all pay off. However, Carter's advice and its visible success inside the interview are weakened (F1). The badge joke keeps the archdeacon device but loses its stated logic (F2).
Entrances and exits are compressed. The cut goes from 'Show her in' straight to the fireplace, and the hall-porter exit is gone (F4). Both remain legible. The location and same-day rewind stay clear.
Turn-taking with Albert, Annie and Rita stays clear. Summarising the Annie and Rysdale exchanges is an authorised compression. Unattributed lines are recoverable from context.

Carter's 'no protection' and the Llanelly reference are kept, as are the wages '£50--£60--whatever you want' and Rita's status as unconfirmed. The trimmed withdrawal clause does not falsify the letter, because 'Whichever way you decide' survives.
Nothing from Chapter VIII leaks in. Tuppence's ignorance of Tommy's whereabouts is kept at dinner ('I wonder where he is'). Rita is not prematurely confirmed as a Brown associate.
V3's undercutting survives. Other narratorial irony in the bluff and Albert's escalating 'pictures' delight were cut in revision (F2). Annie's comic self-exposure is reduced (F3).
The comic-bluff versus sudden-chill contrast is intact, ending on V6/V7. The theme that truth makes the best bluff loses its dramatised confirmation (F1).
All four dependencies are intact at both endpoints in this run's drafts of 011, 013 and 014.

strengths: All seven verbatim anchors survive intact, including 'It was. Tuppence was a great frequenter of the cinema.' and the closing Jane Finn sentence.
Annie's breathless briefing still breaks off on '----' and Rita's steely 'Annie!', preserving the overheard-fragment suspense mechanism.
Rita's portrait keeps the hardened beauty, boring electric-blue eyes and 'metallic strength', so 'For the first time Tuppence felt afraid' turns the tone sharply.
The interview's terse exchanges ('£50--£60--whatever you want', 'My box is at Paddington', 'Prudence Cooper') are kept as performed dialogue, and the alias split is clean.
summary: The revision keeps every planned dependency, all seven verbatim lines, the alias split (Cowley/Prudence Cooper), the timeline and the chill of Rita's entrance. No must-fix defect was found. The main loss is that Carter's 'truth is the best bluff' advice no longer visibly pays off, because the revision cut both the role Tuppence abandons and Rita's relaxing tension. Smaller revision-stage trims also thin the narrator's mock-heroic stage directions in the badge bluff and Annie's comic self-incrimination.
